bank holiday: this monday 26th october is a bank holiday and mass will be at the usual time of 10.00 a.m. eucharistic adoration: eucharistic adoration will not take place this monday as it is a bank holiday all saints day: sunday 1st november is the feast of all saints and mass will be at the usual times – saturday evening 5.30 p.m. (vigil), 9.15 a.m. & 11.00 a.m. feast of all souls: monday 2nd november is the commemoration of all the faithful departed and mass will be at the usual time of 10.00 a.m. altar list of the dead: mass will be offered during the month of november and on the first friday of every month for all those whose names are on the altar list of the dead. envelopes are currently being delivered to each household in the parish and there are also spare envelopes available at the back of the church. envelopes with the names of your deceased loved ones may be placed in the safes at the back of the church or handed into the sacristy for inclusion. month of the holy souls – special mass: a special mass will be celebrated on friday 20th november at 7.30 p.m. for all parishioners who died over the past year, for all our deceased relatives and friends and for all the holy souls. all are welcome to attend. mass intentions: we include up to 5 mass intentions in the announcements at week-end masses (saturday evening and sunday morning). mass intentions should be notified to the sacristy for inclusion at least 3 months in advance to avoid disappointment. ‘tap to pay’ – reminder: tap to pay is available at the back of the church if you would like to contribute towards the necessary funds for the continued maintenance and upkeep of our parish church and grounds - your contributions will go exclusively to the running costs of our parish. time change: please note clocks go back 1 hour this saturday night/sunday morning
